scheduler.contract: Explicit injected asynchronous task ownership and pending/coalescing decisions; native wall-clock timing is unestablished

format.integerParser: Darwin libc strtol(base 0), full-token check, signed int32 truncation
format.strings: Raw bytes; literal control bytes/DEL rejected, quote/backslash and xHH escapes supported

io.dirty: Cleared only on main write/rename success; failure retains dirty; clean flush does not write

oracle.standardIntegerParsing: Delegated to host Darwin libc, not reimplemented in the oracle

limits: No installed Spotify prefs/profile or account data read
Raw byte codec is independent from the strict UTF-8/protobuf bridge
Owned UTF-8 bridge load failures preserve the supplied store; this is an explicit Dart representation boundary
Multi-key registry iteration order and native wall-clock scheduling delay are not byte/timing guarantees
No account-tier checks, live HTTP or runtime sidecar
